summary: Tested Timesheet explicit-pages feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 5/5 pytest passed — creating a timesheet with entries on pages 1 and 2 produces a 2-page PDF grouped correctly with 'Página X de Y' footers; >14 entries on same page returns 400; page=6 returns 400; legacy payloads without page field default to page=1 (single-page PDF); PUT applies same validations and rebuilds pages. Frontend (viewport 500x1000): visually verified — 'Entradas (0)' label present with 'Adicionar página' button always visible (even with 0 entries); 'PÁGINA 1 DE 1 · 0/14' block with 'Adicionar' button; clicking 'Adicionar página' produces 'Entradas (0) · 2 páginas' + 'PÁGINA 2 DE 2 · 0/14' with red trash icon; trash removes the empty last page. OS modal opens and lists OSs. TESTABILITY BUG FOUND: all newly added data-testid attributes are being stripped by React Native Web because RN Web expects the `testID` prop (camelCase), not the HTML attribute `data-testid`. As a result NONE of add-page-btn, page-block-{p}, page-divider-{p}, add-entry-page-{p}-btn, remove-page-{p}-btn, entry-date-btn, entry-employee-btn, entry-service-start-btn, entry-service-end-btn, has-travel-checkbox, entries-count-label, time-picker-none appear in the DOM (verified via document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid],[testid]') → 0 elements on /supervisor/create-timesheet).

testability_bugs.issue: data-testid attributes on TouchableOpacity/View/Text are stripped by React Native Web; use testID (camelCase) which RN Web converts to data-testid in DOM.

action_items: Replace `data-testid="..."` with `testID="..."` on TouchableOpacity/View/Text in /app/frontend/app/supervisor/create-timesheet.tsx and /app/frontend/app/supervisor/edit-timesheet.tsx (RN Web converts testID → data-testid). Functionality already works — this is only for automated-test selector reliability.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/models.py `_validate_timesheet_entries` uses `max(per_page) > 5` where per_page is a dict — this returns the max key (page number), which is what's intended, but the code reads awkwardly. Consider `max(per_page.keys())` or `max(pg for pg in per_page)` for clarity.
In create-timesheet.tsx and edit-timesheet.tsx, `data-testid` on RN components does not reach the DOM under react-native-web. Standardize on `testID` prop across the codebase.

PDF generator loops entries filtering by page but does not warn if `total_pages` exceeds 5 — validation upstream in _validate_timesheet_entries covers this, but a defensive cap in generator would prevent runaway PDFs if a raw doc bypasses validation.

success_rate.frontend: UI verified visually; automated selectors blocked by data-testid vs testID issue

seed_data_creation: Test timesheets are created and deleted per-test via cleanup fixture; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests reusable at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_54_timesheet_pages.py. For frontend automation of RN Web, prefer text-based selectors (page.get_by_text) OR ask main agent to swap `data-testid` for `testID` in RN components. Existing testIDs on core screens (login, etc.) may also have the same issue if written as data-testid.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. Only a minor testability finding: RN Web requires `testID` prop; the `data-testid` HTML attribute the developer added is silently dropped, so Playwright selectors targeting those testids fail. UI itself renders and behaves as specified.
